$comment: The declared state of the org Project (monte3l planning). bin/project-config.mjs reports drift and, with --apply, sets what the GraphQL API allows: title, description, README, Status options, custom fields, issue fields, and each view's name, layout and filter. Group, sort, slice, roadmap dates, visible columns and the built-in workflows are not settable through the API: they are printed as a checklist from the `ui` and `workflows` keys. A view is matched by name (or `renamedFrom`); nothing is ever deleted. Filters use only the syntax on docs.github.com 'Filtering projects' (a space is AND, a comma is OR inside one field, a hyphen negates). Cross-field OR is left out on purpose: the docs say it is unsupported.
title: monte3l planning
shortDescription: Cross-repo hub for the monte3l organization: issues, pull requests, ideas, milestones, releases and roadmaps in one place. Policy: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/blueprint/tracking.md
readmeIntro: One private view of the whole organization, so nobody has to open each repository. Issues and pull requests are added hourly. Open Ideas discussions and stable releases appear as draft items marked by Kind. Where an item belongs is set by the org tracking policy (blueprint/tracking.md). Limits, direction and non-goals stay in each repo's ROADMAP.md.

views.name: In flight
views.ui: Columns by Status. Slice by Repository.

views.name: Roadmap
views.ui: Dates: Start date and Target date. Show milestone markers. Group by Repository.

views.name: Recently changed
views.ui: Sort by Updated, newest first. Done items are archived after 30 days, so this is the last 30 days, releases included.

views.name: Review requests
views.ui: Group by Repository. The docs describe reviewers: as items reviewed by that person: check on the Project that it also lists the PRs waiting for you.

views.name: Pull requests
views.ui: Group by Repository. Show the Assignees and Reviewers columns.

views.name: Ideas
views.ui: Columns by Status. Mirrored discussions carry Kind = Idea discussion and a Source link.

workflows: Item added to project: set Status to Backlog
Item closed: set Status to Done
Pull request merged: set Status to Done
Auto-archive: closed and merged items not updated for 30 days (the docs allow the `is`, `reason` and `updated` filters here: build it in the UI and check its preview)
